scripts.test: npm run clean && NODE_OPTIONS='--loader esm-module-alias/loader' playwright test --config=playwright.config.js
scripts.test:smoketest: npm run clean && RUN_LIGHTHOUSE=true NODE_OPTIONS='--loader esm-module-alias/loader' playwright test --config=playwright.config.js --grep @smoketest
scripts.test:extTestOnly: npm run clean && NODE_OPTIONS='--loader esm-module-alias/loader' playwright test --config=playwright.config.js --grep @extTestOnly
scripts.test:browserstack: npm run clean && NODE_OPTIONS='--loader esm-module-alias/loader' node_modules/.bin/browserstack-node-sdk playwright test --config=playwright.browserstack.config.js
scripts.test:local: npm run clean && NODE_OPTIONS='--loader esm-module-alias/loader' playwright test --config=playwright.config.js
scripts.test:local:admin: npm run clean && NODE_OPTIONS='--loader esm-module-alias/loader' playwright test --config=playwright.config.js 'specs/admin/'
scripts.test:local:debug: npm run clean && NODE_OPTIONS='--loader esm-module-alias/loader' DEBUG=true playwright test --config=playwright.config.js
scripts.test:local:grep: npm run clean && NODE_OPTIONS='--loader esm-module-alias/loader' playwright test --config=playwright.config.js --grep "$GREP"
scripts.test:localonly: npm run clean && NODE_OPTIONS='--loader esm-module-alias/loader' playwright test --config=playwright.localonly.config.js
scripts.test:localonly:grep: npm run clean && NODE_OPTIONS='--loader esm-module-alias/loader' playwright test --config=playwright.localonly.config.js --grep "$GREP"
scripts.test:github: npm run clean && npm run test:github:browser
scripts.test:github:browserstack: npm run clean && NODE_OPTIONS='--loader esm-module-alias/loader' node_modules/.bin/browserstack-node-sdk playwright test --config=playwright.browserstack.config.js || touch FAILED
scripts.test:clock: npm run clean && FAKE_CLOCK_FILE=$PWD/test/support/simulator/clock/clock.txt NODE_OPTIONS="--loader esm-module-alias/loader --import $PWD/test/support/simulator/clock/fake-clock.mjs" playwright test
scripts.setup:husky: node -e "try { (await import('husky')).default() } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }" --input-type module
